acceptanceCriteria: Line sits above the level number and fades with it, including the Reduce Motion crossfade
Timer starts at input unlock, stops at the goal move and excludes pauses
Value is display only: not persisted, sent or written to receipts
new.description: The between-levels banner shows Completion Time: MM:SS above the level number, fading with it. It uses the existing per-level run timer (start when input opens, stop at the goal, hold time excluded), is display only and never stored or sent.
new.title: Show the level clear time above the level number between levels

acceptanceCriteria: Only one fill is ever drawn inside a diamond
Fill grows inner to outer and drains outer to inner, with the Reduce Motion crossfade kept
All 8 diamonds show on the owner phone (needs phone model, mode and a bottom-edge screenshot)
new.description: The old instant half-size core on wrap-end diamonds is removed so the beam fill is the only interior colour. The fill grows from the inner tip and drains outer tip first. Owner reported two bottom diamonds missing in play: not reproduced headlessly, cause unconfirmed (hypothesis: rounded display corners clip the full-bleed corner kites).
new.title: Edge diamonds: one fill only, fill inner to outer, drain outer to inner

acceptanceCriteria: Star centroid within 0.5 device px of the painted interior centre on all tile shapes and DPRs
Star size and look unchanged
Owner confirms the centring on a phone
new.description: The goal star was centred by its bounding box and sat 1 to 2 device px low on every tile, up to 3.7 on corner tiles. It is now drawn on its circumcentre at the centre of the painted chip fill (bulb centre on dead ends).
new.title: Centre the goal star by its centre of mass in the tile

acceptanceCriteria: A small stable subset of stars shows a slow rainbow hue
Reduce Motion keeps colour shifting without movement and adds no per-frame full redraw
Owner confirms the tint reads on a phone
new.description: About 20 percent of backdrop stars (chosen by a stable per-star seed) keep a dim rainbow hue that cycles once per 24 s with per-star phase offsets. Reduce Motion stops drift and twinkle but colours keep shifting.
new.title: Keep a few background stars rainbow-coloured

acceptanceCriteria: Arrow centroid within 0.5 device px of the painted interior centre
Size and keyline unchanged
Owner confirms on a phone
new.description: The start arrow was bounding-box centred. It is now centred by the centroid of its painted pixels on the tile painted-interior centre, like the goal star. Four corner raster baselines were refreshed.
new.title: Centre the start arrow by its painted centroid

acceptanceCriteria: 283 and 288 are in the jump list
A test pins them to the felt saturation and last budget constants
Existing checkpoints are kept
new.description: The level preview jump list ended at 218 then 300 while the ladder ends at 288. 283 (felt saturation) and 288 (last budget level) are added and pinned to their constants.
new.title: Add ladder-end checkpoints 283 and 288 to the level preview

acceptanceCriteria: Events fold deterministically with evidence rules enforced
Trigger policy and rollback are documented
The Board sync workflow is proven once on GitHub
new.description: Board changes are recorded as one event line each (board-events branch) and folded by a deterministic script at milestones into the registry, ledger, export, work report and Web snapshot. Replaces the per-PR agent edit. Docs: docs/ops/MAZER-BOARD-SYNC-PROCESS.md.
new.title: Board updates by event log and milestone fold, not per PR

acceptanceCriteria: Dev and QA pages and legacy sw.js are out of the precache
Update behaviour on deploy is decided and documented
Mid-level restore after the reload is measured
new.description: The production precache ships about 300 KiB of dev and QA pages plus the legacy sw.js, and a new deploy reloads a running session about 1.5 s after the update check with no prompt. Decide the update behaviour (prompt or deferred) and measure mid-level restore.
new.title: Trim dev pages from the precache and decide update behaviour on deploy
